reviews.title: Great Graphics Card
reviews.comment: This is my Second AMD Graphics Card. They Both are working good. Just what I needed for my I5 motherboards. I Highly recommend this Card and Seller. Thanks
reviews.author: Titan

reviews.title: Middle of the road.  Better than stock on-board graphics chips.
reviews.comment: Mediocre card.  Works well for none graphics intensive games like Sims or older RTS games.  Great graphics and color.  Resolution and monitor support fantastic.  It's just on the slow end for many faster paced games.
reviews.author: Jim M.

reviews.title: Not an R5 chipset
reviews.comment: Not an R5. It shows as an HD 5450 chipset in the Windows 11 device manager. The frame rate is pitiful. I’ve been bamdoozled.

reviews.title: works great in my older machine
reviews.comment: I use Ubuntu, which sometimes didn't play well with my original Nvidia based card. This took care of that, with no performance loss, at a very reasonable cost. It's for sure NOT a gamer card, but it does the job without any drama.
